{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Create a new item and try to link it into goggles (glasses) slot.
{{Feature | informative | This command does '''not''' add NVGs, which are [[hmd]] slot items (see [[linkItem]] instead).}}

|s1= unit [[addGoggles]] type

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|p2= type: [[String]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>player addGoggles "G_Tactical_Clear";</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>diver addGoggles "G_Diving";</sqf>

|seealso= [[goggles]] [[removeGoggles]]
}}
